verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the Employment & Labor page, which notes a partner nationally recognized for handling non-compete and trade-secret misappropriation matters. That implies some trade-secret dispute work, but it never says the firm litigates these matters or names any court, venue or outcome. The firm's other IP-related pages cover transactional work (licensing, IP ownership, open-source compliance), not disputes. Missing for 10: explicit IP litigation practice, patent and trademark dispute work, named courts or venues, described case outcomes, independent corroboration.
